fusions.name: Wrenching Haul
fusions.desc: Hurls a link that deals 16 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and knocks the target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Crushing Squeeze
fusions.desc: Tightens a ring of links around you, dealing 34 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Drag Line
fusions.desc: Hauls up to 6 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Taut Line
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises by 40% for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
